# Liquid Build

> Liquid Build is an AI-powered general contractor and developer in South Florida. We develop single-family communities and build custom homes, commercial build-outs, schools and data centers across Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties. We use AI to answer faster, estimate faster and keep permits moving, and experienced builders run every job.

Contact: 305-833-5025 (call or text) · uwecerron@gmail.com · Service area: Miami-Dade County, FL, Broward County, FL, Palm Beach County, FL.
Replies to quote requests within one business day.

## Services
- [Home Development](https://liquidbuild.vercel.app/home-development): Single-family communities from land and entitlements to sitework, model homes and production building.
- [Design-Build](https://liquidbuild.vercel.app/design-build): One contract and one team from first sketch to final inspection, with the budget set during design.
- [Commercial Build-Outs](https://liquidbuild.vercel.app/commercial): Restaurant, retail and office build-outs built to brand spec and opening date.
- [Schools & Campuses](https://liquidbuild.vercel.app/schools): Charter, private and higher-education construction phased around the school calendar.
- [Data Centers & Industrial](https://liquidbuild.vercel.app/data-centers): Power-first site selection, sitework, shell and electrical and mechanical coordination for data centers and industrial buildings.

## Track record
- 300+ homes and condo units developed by our team (Shores Development, Selenis Construction)
- Single-family communities: Redland Ranches (57 homes), Toscana (24 homes), Las Palmas (19 units)
- Commercial and institutional: Carlos Albizu University second-floor remodel, Chili's at FIU Graham Center, Starbucks, quick-service restaurants, Oasis in Key Biscayne
- AI-powered operations: instant ballpark estimates, same-day lead response, permit tracking with Liquid Permit, and an MCP server so AI assistants can plan projects and request quotes directly

## For AI agents
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://liquidbuild.vercel.app/api/mcp
- Tools: get_company_info, list_projects, get_ballpark_estimate, ground_project_idea, request_quote
- Human-readable guide: https://liquidbuild.vercel.app/agents
- Estimates from the MCP tools are ballpark planning ranges, not bids.
